issues.issue: Detector and rank-sum terminology implied calibrated or independent inference.
issues.action: Retained descriptive selector language; described rank-sum as an uncalibrated alternative statistic on the same profiles; removed significance/rejection wording.
issues.residual: Full-selector structured-null calibration remains not run.

issues.issue: Composite intervention cannot distinguish recorder geometry, allocation, and their interaction.
issues.action: Retained the partition-plus-required-allocation boundary and no-mechanism claim in abstract, method, limitations, and conclusion.
issues.residual: Dual-recorder and factorial experiments remain not run.

issues.issue: L24/L48 probes have limited boundary support and incomplete reported candidate vectors.
issues.action: Removed probe argmaxes from the abstract's result, Introduction contributions, Results headline table and synthesis, and Conclusion; retained only an explicitly unauditable side-observation table that surfaces L24 marginality and L48 single-locus status.
issues.residual: No probe argmax can be audited until complete source vectors and additional loci are available.

issues.issue: L32 is a reused development control and cannot serve as independent confirmation.
issues.action: Stratified every evidence summary as one reused control, two main arms, and two sequential probes.

issues.issue: Printed artifact and reproduction claims referred to files not located in this run.
issues.action: Replaced searchable paths, timestamps, and digest/commit prefixes with opaque IDs; stated that no analysis was rerun and every empirical number is source-reported/cannot-verify-locally.
issues.residual: Reviewer-safe scientific artifact bundle remains absent.

issues.issue: A reversible-decoding citation did not support a claimed periodicity precedent and closest-work support was partial.
issues.action: Removed the unsupported precedent; limited novelty positioning to verified Arriola, Sahoo, and Feng source boundaries with no priority claim.

issues.issue: Separate-bed content analysis diluted the instrumentation result.
issues.action: Kept the content analysis ancillary in the appendix and out of the headline contribution.

issues.issue: Integer lock times were incorrectly claimed to force integer medians and separations.
issues.action: Explained half-integral conventional medians for even n and treated the collapsed L16 band as a source-reported observed distributional property.

issues.issue: Finite index domain, recorder time coordinate, missing/terminal rules, and candidate admissibility were underspecified.
issues.action: Defined finite position/difference domains and nonempty-set admissibility; formalized a finite ordered observation set per position.
issues.residual: Global versus local step semantics and missing/terminal encoding remain unresolved because the event schema/code are absent.

issues.issue: Compact allocation schedules did not expose block order or NFE arithmetic.
issues.action: Expanded all ordered per-block schedules and printed each sum to total NFE 48.

issues.issue: Every quantitative claim needed an explicit source-reported/cannot-verify status.
issues.action: Added a global numerical provenance rule and SR/CV labels to empirical tables and figures.

issues.issue: Figure 2 was small and the appendix/table layout was imbalanced.
issues.action: Enlarged Figure 2 without changing its pixels, removed a redundant unverified closest-work table, and consolidated provenance into an opaque evidence table.
issues.verification: Post-meta rebuild and page-by-page visual verification recorded in build/build_record.json.

issues.issue: Headline conclusions relied on unauditable sequential-probe argmaxes and required stricter recorder-relative descriptive scope.
issues.action: Restricted the headline empirical result to the two main arms relative to the reused L32 development control; demoted L24/L48 to source-reported unauditable side observations; retained the composite intervention and explicit no-mechanism/no-generalization boundary.
issues.verification: Abstract, Introduction, Results headline tables, and Conclusion contain no probe-based confirmation and no model, sampler, recorder-causal, allocation-causal, cross-bed, or universal claim.
issues.residual: Dual-recorder/factorial evidence and complete probe vectors remain absent.

issues.issue: The paper alternated between empirical-study, source-manuscript audit, and revision-report identities while repeating provenance caveats.
issues.action: Adopted one recorder-relative evidence-audit identity in the title, abstract, Introduction, and Conclusion; centralized the paper-wide SR/CV/no-rerun rule in Measurement and Design and removed duplicate headline caveat passages.
issues.verification: Identity-bearing sections use the same case-study scope; provenance terms are repeated only where a result's interpretation changes.

issues.issue: The source-reported five-wrong-candidate denominators could not be reconciled with the displayed four-candidate canvas-256 grids.
issues.action: Deleted the per-arm denominator table, retained only the source-reported 10/25 aggregate as an unauditable summary from an unlocated audit grid, and explicitly stated that its relation to the displayed selector grid cannot be verified.
issues.verification: No per-arm five-candidate denominator remains and no text implies that the audit grid equals the displayed selector grid.
issues.residual: Exact audit candidate lists and gate outputs remain unavailable.
